searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: Skool discovery searches, e.g. fitness, AI automation, real estate. Empty = the discovery front page (trending).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Only communities in these Skool categories. Empty = all.

communityUrls.title: Community URLs
communityUrls.description: Specific communities to look up, e.g. https://www.skool.com/ai-automation-society or just ai-automation-society.

maxMembers.title: Maximum members
maxMembers.description: Skip larger communities. Empty = no limit. Useful for finding growing creators rather than the giants.

includeOwner.title: Owner details
includeOwner.description: Open each community's about page for the owner's name, bio, website and social links, plus posts, courses, admins and members online. Off = discovery data only, faster.

maxCommunities.title: Maximum communities
maxCommunities.description: Stop after this many communities in total. Skool discovery shows up to 1,000 per search.
